review_rules: Pre-ri'Datta and Riddle'Thar-era Khajiiti religion must remain historically distinct traditions with documented continuities and changes
Do not automatically equate Khajiiti deities with similarly named Imperial or Aldmeri gods; model proposed correspondences as relationships with evidence
Amun-dro, Clan Mother Ahnissi and Moon-Bishop traditions retain authorship, period and doctrinal perspective
Furstock and lunar-cycle claims should distinguish cultural doctrine, observed births and game simplification
Dro-m'Athra and Bent Dance descriptions should separate religious interpretation from directly observed phenomena
Cross-link existing Khajiit, Azurah, Alkosh, Riddle'Thar, Lunar Lattice, Mane, Dro-m'Athra, Lorkhaj, Elsweyr, Anequina and Pellitine records
